lead: Hridaynath Mangeshkar is an Indian actor, born on 26 October 1937 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, he is 88 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has 54 credited works on public record and has been recognised with National Film Award for Best Music Direction and Padma Shri in arts.
This profile collects the Hridaynath facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Hridaynath Mangeshkar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Hridaynath Mangeshkar was born on 26 October 1937 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Deenanath Mangeshkar. He is a sibling of Asha Bhosle, Lata Mangeshkar, Usha Mangeshkar and Meena Khadikar.
He received his education at Balmohan Vidyamandir.
